talents.name: Penance
descriptions: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing <!--ppl30:39:42:29-->45 Holy damage to an enemy, or <!--ppl30:39:126:87-->134 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

talents.name: Renewed Hope
descriptions: Your heals from Flash Heal, Binding Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, and Penance gain 10% increased critical strike chance when cast on targets with Weakened Soul, and reduce the remaining duration of Weakened Soul on their target by 5 sec.

talents.name: Power Infusion
descriptions: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.

talents.name: Mental Strength
descriptions: Increases your total Intellect by 15%.

talents.name: Improved Mana Burn
descriptions: Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by 1.0 sec.

talents.name: Soul Warding
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown on your Power Word: Shield spell by 4 sec and reduces its mana cost by 15%.

talents.name: Divine Aegis
descriptions: Your critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing 15% of the amount healed. Lasts 12 sec.

talents.name: Improved Inner Fire
descriptions: Increases the Armor bonus of your Inner Fire spell by 45% and increases its total charges by 12.

talents.name: Mental Agility
descriptions: Reduces the mana cost of your Smite, Holy Fire, and instant cast spells by 10%.

talents.name: Meditation
descriptions: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Inner Focus
descriptions: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.

talents.name: Martyrdom
descriptions: Gives you a 0% chance to gain Focused Casting for 6 sec after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike. The Focused Casting effect prevents you from losing casting time when taking damage and increases your resistance to Interrupt effects by 20%.

talents.name: Improved Power Word: Shield
descriptions: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 20%.

talents.name: Silent Resolve
descriptions: Reduces the threat generated by your Holy spells by 30% and reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects inflicted on you by 15%.

talents.name: Twin Disciplines
descriptions: Increases the damage and healing of your instant cast spells by 5%.

talents.name: Wand Specialization
descriptions: Increases your damage with Wands by 25%.

talents.name: Holy Precision
descriptions: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%.

talents.name: Power in Light
descriptions: Your Smite and Penance spells deal 15% increased damage to targets afflicted with your Holy Fire.

talents.name: Prayer of Mending
descriptions: Places a spell on the target that heals them for [(172 + (Healing * <!--bc-->0.42899999<!--bc-->)) * (<!--sp1225132:0-->1<!--sp1225132--> * <!--sp14898:0-->1<!--sp14898-->)] the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yards. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.

talents.name: Spiritual Healing
descriptions: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 2%.

talents.name: Spiritual Guidance
descriptions: Increases your spell healing by up to 25% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 8% of your total Spirit.

talents.name: Spirit of Redemption
descriptions: Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec.  The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects.  While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost.  When the effect ends, the priest dies.

talents.name: Litany of Light
descriptions: When you cast a healing spell, gain Mana equal to 20% of the base cost of the spell if your previous heal was a different spell.

talents.name: Binding Heal
descriptions: Heals a friendly target and the caster for <!--ppl25:31:247:220-->236 to 284. Low threat.

talents.name: Searing Light
descriptions: Increases your Holy damage done by 10%, and gives a 10% chance each time your Holy Fire spell deals periodic damage for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.

talents.name: Improved Healing
descriptions: Reduces the Mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Penance, and Prayer of Mending spells by 15%.

talents.name: Holy Reach
descriptions: Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells and the radius of your Prayer of Healing and Holy Nova spells by 10%.

talents.name: Inspiration
descriptions: Your non-periodic critical heals increase your target's Armor by 0% for 15 sec.

talents.name: Blessed Recovery
descriptions: After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, or suffering more than 30% of your maximum Health from a single attack, heal 8% of the damage taken over 6 sec. Refreshing this effect carries over any remaining healing.

talents.name: Holy Nova
descriptions: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing <!--ppl20:26:27:20-->26 to 30 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for <!--ppl20:26:51:40-->50 to 57. These effects cause no threat.

talents.name: Divine Fury
descriptions: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal, and Greater Heal spells by 1 sec.

talents.name: Spell Warding
descriptions: Reduces all spell damage taken by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Renew
descriptions: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 5%.

talents.name: Twilight Focus
descriptions: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any spell.

talents.name: Holy Specialization
descriptions: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 1%.

talents.name: Shadowform
descriptions: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.

talents.name: Darkness
descriptions: Increases your Shadow damage done by 10%.

talents.name: Devouring Contagion
descriptions:
Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 50%.

Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to a nearby enemy within 10 yds for the remaining duration.

talents.name: Vampiric Embrace
descriptions: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec.

talents.name: Shadow Weaving
descriptions: Your Shadow damage spells have a 100% chance to increase the Shadow damage you deal by 2% for 15 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.name: Improved Fade
descriptions: Decreases the cooldown of your Fade ability by 6 sec.

talents.name: Silence
descriptions: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

talents.name: Improved Mind Flay
descriptions: Your Mind Flay now deals 20% more damage, gains 10 yards increased range, but slows the target's movement speed by 80%.

talents.name: Mind Flay
descriptions: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec  and slowing their movement speed by <!--sp1225139:0-->50<!--sp1225139-->%.

talents.name: Improved Mind Blast
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by 3 sec.

talents.name: Improved Psychic Scream
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by 4 sec.

talents.name: Shadow Reach
descriptions: Increases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by 20%.

talents.name: Improved Shadow Word: Pain
descriptions: Increases the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by 6 sec.

talents.name: Shadow Affinity
descriptions: Reduces the threat generated by your Shadow spells by 8%.

talents.name: Blackout
descriptions: Gives your Shadow damage spells a 10% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Spirit Tap
descriptions: Gives you a 0% chance to increase your Spirit by 100% for 15 sec after killing a non-trivial target or when an enemy afflicted by your Vampiric Embrace dies. For the duration, 50% of your Mana regeneration will continue while casting.

talents.name: Shadow Focus
descriptions: Improves your chance to hit with Shadow spells by 5%.

talents.name: Early Demise
descriptions: Increases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below 20% health by 30%.
